solution.p: 5pz=-23 is not linear because it multiplies two variables together.
y^{2}+x^{2}=74 and \pi r^{2}\gt48\pi are not linear because variables are raised to the second power.
\left|3.3x+2\right|=-6 is not linear because a variable is within absolute value bars.
That leaves 18x-3\leq60 and q\sqrt{29}=-65\text{,} which are both linear.
